apps.name: Conway's Game of Life
apps.description: Cellular automaton on the 16x16 Stellar Unicorn. Draw a pattern, or seed it at random, then watch it run.

apps.name: Image Shower
apps.description: Pick an image file and display it on the Stellar Unicorn. Handles PNG, JPEG, BMP, WebP and animated GIF.

apps.name: Platform Game
apps.description: A side-scrolling platform game on the Stellar Unicorn, with chiptune from the panel's own speaker. Arrow keys run, jump and climb; collect every coin to open the goal. Sixty levels, four demon boss fights, and a dozen kinds of block. The menu and the level picker are drawn on the panel itself.

apps.name: Panel Self-Test
apps.description: Check the link to the Stellar Unicorn one layer at a time, then light the panel up. Run this first when the panel stays dark.

apps.name: Flash Panel Firmware
apps.description: Copy the frame server onto the Stellar Unicorn's Pico over USB. Run this once when setting up, and again after updating pi-menu.
